Each dataset is released on the domains below, one package per domain, dataset and grid
on [Helmholtz Codebase](https://codebase.helmholtz.cloud/fesmc/fesmdata-products/-/packages).
The files of each grid are listed at the end of the page of each dataset, under
Downloads; download them with `fesmdata.jl` (see [Download](download.qmd)) or one by one.
What each dataset contains is under [Datasets](datasets.qmd), the domains and their grids
under [Domains and grids](domains.qmd).
